experience_sharing.TopResource: ["Program Incentives ","Vouchers provided by AWS Cloud Team","Skillbuilder Courses","Youtube videos, Practice Exams"]
experience_sharing.Experience:
I was able to pass my certification because of my family's support and my eagerness to learn. Since I'm still new to the company and to cloud technology, I challenged myself to gain as much knowledge as I could.

While I don't have extensive hands-on experience with AWS yet, I'm very willing to learn and improve so I can keep up with the people I work with on different projects. To prepare for the certification, I spent a lot of time watching YouTube videos about AWS Cloud Practitioner topics and checking my understanding through practice exams. I stayed consistent with my study routine, and all the effort paid off when I passed the certification.

experience_sharing.TopResource: ["Vouchers provided by AWS Cloud Team","Program Incentives ","Udemy Access"]
experience_sharing.Experience:
First, I took a practice exam on Udemy to identify my weak areas. Based on the results, I focused my preparation on those topics and spent the next two weeks strengthening my knowledge.

After two weeks, I retook the practice exam and was able to pass it. To further validate my preparation, I used Gemini to generate additional quizzes and completed five different practice papers.

This approach helped me identify my knowledge gaps, focus on the areas that needed improvement, and build confidence before taking the actual certification exam.

I also published the practice papers on GitHub so that others preparing for the AWS Networking Specialty certification can use them for their own practice.

https://github.com/ssurya-1691/aws-networking-speciality-certification-practice

experience_sharing.CertName: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
experience_sharing.Experience: The Udemy mock exams were the most helpful resource in preparing for my certification. They allowed me to assess my readiness, identify weak areas, and become familiar with the style and difficulty of the actual exam questions. I reviewed every incorrect answer and studied the underlying AWS concepts instead of simply memorizing the questions. Repeating the practice exams also helped improve my confidence, time management, and understanding of how AWS services are applied in different scenarios.
